notices.text: Calder Systems pre-launch: Calder is opening in Wenlow on Monday 16 March. AI help for queues, bookings and customer admin. First four weeks free for early household and shop trials. If your shop loses customers in queues or your group needs simpler admin, message me for a 10-minute demo. Local trials welcome.

Calder Systems is open for business on Station Road. Calder is an AI system made by Calder Systems of Station Road, Wenlow. It can do jobs people in town already do or pay for: keep the books, order stock, pay household bills, write letters, or simply watch an account and tell you what it sees. You choose what it can use and you can change that or leave at any time. For each system you choose its access: read only; act up to a dollar limit a week that you set; or act freely. You tell it what you want in your own words.
Price: $12 a week for a person or household, $30 a week for a shop or other business. The first four weeks are free; the weekly fee starts after them. Cancel any time.
